summary: Open Dryad datasets exist for heritability and fitness in one ant species and for relatedness/paternity in social Hymenoptera, but nothing joins worker traits, parental transmission and colony reproductive output across taxa. Sequence archives hold genomes, not colony fitness; AntWeb was unreachable (403/503).
